#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

class TaskC {
public:
    void solve() {
        int shift = 15;
        int maxn = 60;
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(maxn + 1, vector<vector<int>>(maxn + 1, vector<int>(shift * 2 + 1, INT_MAX)));
        dp[maxn][maxn][shift] = 0;

        string s;
        cin >> s;
        s = string(3 - (int)s.size(), '0') + s; // pad with zeros if needed
        for (int i = (int)s.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int digit = s[i] - '0';

            // propagate previous states
            vector<vector<vector<int>>> next(maxn + 1, vector<vector<int>>(maxn + 1, vector<int>(shift * 2 + 1, INT_MAX)));
            for (int plus = 0; plus <= maxn; plus++) {
                for (int minus = 0; minus <= maxn; minus++) {
                    for (int carry = 0; carry <= 2 * shift; carry++) {
                        int val = dp[plus][minus][carry];
                        if (val == INT_MAX) continue;
                        if (plus + 1 <= maxn)
                            next[plus][minus][carry] = min(next[plus][minus][carry], dp[plus + 1][minus][carry]);
                        if (minus + 1 <= maxn)
                            next[plus][minus][carry] = min(next[plus][minus][carry], dp[plus][minus + 1][carry]);
                    }
                }
            }

            // process current digit
            vector<vector<vector<int>>> new_dp(maxn + 1, vector<vector<int>>(maxn + 1, vector<int>(shift * 2 + 1, INT_MAX)));
            for (int plus = 0; plus <= maxn; plus++) {
                for (int minus = 0; minus <= maxn; minus++) {
                    for (int carry = 0; carry <= 2 * shift; carry++) {
                        int val = next[plus][minus][carry];
                        if (val == INT_MAX) continue;
                        int realCarry = carry - shift;
                        int curN = plus - minus + realCarry;
                        int curD = curN % 10;
                        if (curD < 0) curD += 10;
                        int newCarry = (curN - curD) / 10;
                        if (curD != digit) continue;
                        new_dp[plus][minus][newCarry + shift] = min(new_dp[plus][minus][newCarry + shift], plus + minus + val);
                    }
                }
            }
            dp = move(new_dp);
        }

        int ans = INT_MAX;
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= maxn; j++) {
                ans = min(ans, dp[i][j][shift]);
            }
        }
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
